notes: Generated by tools/tubuild.py create for 27 functions, then reconciled by hand, then widened by hand to the whole unit once func_ov006_020e20bc matched. See the file's own header comment for what was and was not reconciled.

DESTRUCTOR / CODEGEN GRID, measured on this class with tools/tubuild.py verify, six cells. Axes: dtor declaration {out-of-line (as include/dScMgCurling_c.h ships it), inline-in-class} x codegen {deferred (mwccarm default), #pragma defer_codegen off} x source order {ROM-ascending, ROM-descending}. (a) out-of-line + defer_codegen off + ascending: 27/27 MATCH, objisolate clean, 'all 27 function(s) in the expected ROM-ascending section order'. ADOPTED. (b) out-of-line + defer_codegen off + descending: 27/27 MATCH, but emission order reports 25 ordinal pair(s) NOT in ROM order -- the bytes are right and the section order is not, so it is not adoptable for a contiguous .text claim. (c) out-of-line + deferred + ascending: 24/27; func_ov006_020e1608, func_ov006_020e1680 and func_ov006_020e1854 regress, and emission order reports 26 pairs out of order. (d) out-of-line + deferred + descending: 23/27; the same three regress plus func_ov006_020e1dc8. (e) inline-in-class + defer_codegen off + ascending: 25/27 -- _ZN14dScMgCurling_cD1Ev and _ZN14dScMgCurling_cD0Ev come back MISSING, 'not in the compiled object'. (f) inline-in-class + deferred + ascending: 22/27 -- the same two MISSING plus the same three DIFFs as (c). READINGS. The out-of-line declaration is REQUIRED, not stylistic: with the destructor inline in the class the TU emits no D1 and no D0 at all, so ordinals 0 and 1 of the licensed range would have no source. The bracketed #pragma regions around the five pragma-carrying members only bind under defer_codegen off, which is worth exactly those three members (020e1608, 020e1680, 020e1854) and is worth the SAME three in both destructor rows -- so on this class the pragma's effect does NOT invert across the destructor axis, which is recorded as a refutation of that hypothesis rather than as a confirmed rule. defer_codegen off also makes source order bind, which is why the file is written in ROM-ascending order; under deferred codegen the emission order is reversed and neither source order produces a ROM-ascending object.

D2 EXISTENCE, checked before arguing from its absence. _ZN14dScMgCurling_cD2Ev appears in no symbols.txt anywhere in the tree -- config/arm9/symbols.txt, the itcm/dtcm tables and all 103 overlay tables were searched -- and in no delinks.txt. D1 (0x020e0638) and D0 (0x020e065c) are 0x24 apart, exactly D1's size, so there is no room for a D2 between them either. build/rtti.json holds exactly one edge mentioning this class and it names it as the DERIVED side, so nothing derives from dScMgCurling_c and its D2 is never odr-used. The variant mwcc emits is therefore homeless and is dispositioned deadstrip.

EXTERN RECONCILIATION. The per-function shards disagreed about four spellings and the disagreements were resolved by measurement, not by preference. (1) cstd::atan2 was recovered as returning u16 by the shard that held func_ov006_020e1854 and as returning int by the one that held func_ov006_020e1dc8; the int spelling is kept, because 020e1dc8 needs it to match and 020e1854 matches either way. (2) data_0209d4b8 was recovered once as a scalar and once as an array; the scalar spelling is kept. (3) data_020a0dea and data_020a0deb were indexed as u8[] by the shard that held func_ov006_020e1c68 and needed a 4-byte-strided struct by the one that held func_ov006_020e1b54 -- that shard's own banner records that a plain u8[] costs it 18 words. Both are declared as the 4-byte struct and 020e1c68's two reads are respelled through a u8 * cast; both members still match. (4) func_ov006_020e1dc8's first parameter was forward-declared char * by one shard and defined dScMgCurling_c * by another; the class-pointer spelling is kept.

The incomplete struct C and the PMF/Entry typedefs above the member blocks are load-bearing: they are the representation the pointer-to-member tables at 0x0213c1e4..0x0213c2bc are filled with by __sinit_ov006_*, and completing struct C changes the pointer-to-member representation mwcc emits.

func_ov006_020e1608 took its parameter as `this` in its .c shard; `this` is a keyword once the shard is compiled as C++, so the parameter and its one body use are spelled `self` here. The emitted bytes are unchanged.

FOLD RECONCILIATION, upper 19 + the hole, each settled by measurement with tools/tubuild.py verify (46/46). (1) cstd::atan2 keeps the int return the lower half needed; func_ov006_020e20bc matches with it too. (2) func_ov004_020adc1c is declared (void); the Render shard declared it with one argument and passed func_ov004_020adc1c() nothing, and the bytes are the same. (3) LoadFile returns void * (its shard's spelling); func_ov006_020e3250 assigns it to a void * local. (4) func_ov006_020e3388 takes the scene as char * rather than the int its shard used; its opt_strength_reduction off is now a push/pop bracket. (5) func_ov006_020e26f8 reads data_020a0de8 through the same 4-byte-record cast the lower half uses for data_020a0dea/data_020a0deb; indexing the TU's u8[] directly swaps two registers and costs 26 words. (6) func_ov006_020e285c is the one-instruction tail veneer onto func_ov006_020e20bc and is written as a plain call; mwcc emits the ldr ip / bx ip pair itself. (7) The state tables data_ov006_021418b0 and data_ov006_02141950 read by func_ov006_020e3078 and Behavior are typed through the same incomplete receiver C as the four lower tables, as PMF0 (no argument); Behavior reads its state index through PopupView, which already names the word at 0x4eac.

Static initializer folded: the seven PMF state tables (0x021418b0..0x02141978) move out of the handwritten src/unnamed shard into src/actors/dScMgCurling_c.cpp, defined through the existing PMF/PMF0/Entry typedefs and plain-copied from the ROM PMF constants at data_ov006_0213c1e4..0x0213c2bc.
